# === Import ===

--8<-- [start:import]
-import_from(scipy_sparse, [make_csr, make_csc, make_coo, make_diagonals, make_eye, ...])
--8<-- [end:import]

--8<-- [start:import_ex2]
-import_from(py.scipy_sparse, [make_csr, ...])
--8<-- [end:import_ex2]


# === Tier 3 — Construction ===

--8<-- [start:makecsr]
make_csr(DATA, INDICES, INDPTR, RESULT)
make_csr(DATA, INDICES, INDPTR, SHAPE, RESULT)
make_csr(DATA, INDICES, INDPTR, SHAPE, DTYPE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makecsr]

--8<-- [start:makecsr_ex2]
DATA is ++([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]),
IDX  is ++([0, 1, 2]),
PTR  is ++([0, 1, 2, 3]),
make_csr(DATA, IDX, PTR, H)
--8<-- [end:makecsr_ex2]

--8<-- [start:makecsc]
make_csc(DATA, INDICES, INDPTR, RESULT)
make_csc(DATA, INDICES, INDPTR, SHAPE, RESULT)
make_csc(DATA, INDICES, INDPTR, SHAPE, DTYPE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makecsc]

--8<-- [start:makecoo]
make_coo(DATA, ROW, COL, RESULT)
make_coo(DATA, ROW, COL, SHAPE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makecoo]

--8<-- [start:makecoo_ex2]
DATA is ++([1.0, 2.0]),
ROW  is ++([0, 1]),
COL  is ++([1, 0]),
make_coo(DATA, ROW, COL, ++(tuple([2, 2])), H)
--8<-- [end:makecoo_ex2]

--8<-- [start:makediagonals]
make_diagonals(DIAGONALS, RESULT)
make_diagonals(DIAGONALS, OFFSETS, RESULT)
make_diagonals(DIAGONALS, OFFSETS, SHAPE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makediagonals]

--8<-- [start:makediagonals_ex2]
make_diagonals(++([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]), H)        % 3x3 identity-like diagonal
make_diagonals(++([1.0, 2.0]), 1, ++(tuple([3, 3])), H)   % superdiagonal
--8<-- [end:makediagonals_ex2]

--8<-- [start:makeeye]
make_eye(N, RESULT)
make_eye(N, M, RESULT)
make_eye(N, M, K, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makeeye]

--8<-- [start:makeeye_ex2]
make_eye(4, H),
to_dense(H, D)   % D is the 4x4 identity matrix
--8<-- [end:makeeye_ex2]


# === Tier 3 — Conversions ===

--8<-- [start:todense]
to_dense(HANDLE, RESULT)
to_dense(HANDLE, ORDER, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:todense]

--8<-- [start:fromdense]
from_dense(DENSE, RESULT)
from_dense(DENSE, FORMAT, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:fromdense]

--8<-- [start:fromdense_ex2]
A is ++([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 2.0]]),
from_dense(A, 'csc', H)
--8<-- [end:fromdense_ex2]


# === Tier 3 — Inspection ===

--8<-- [start:shape]
shape(HANDLE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:shape]

--8<-- [start:shape_ex2]
shape(H, S),
R is ++(S[0]),
C is ++(S[1])
--8<-- [end:shape_ex2]

--8<-- [start:nonzerocount]
nonzero_count(HANDLE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:nonzerocount]


# === scipy.sparse.linalg ===

--8<-- [start:solve]
solve(A, B, RESULT)
solve(A, B, PERMC_SPEC, RESULT)
solve(A, B, PERMC_SPEC, USE_UMFPACK, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:solve]

--8<-- [start:solve_ex2]
make_csr(DATA, IDX, PTR, ++(tuple([3, 3])), A),
solve(A, B, X),
free(A)
--8<-- [end:solve_ex2]

--8<-- [start:eigendecomposehermitian]
eigen_decompose_hermitian(A, RESULT)
eigen_decompose_hermitian(A, K, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:eigendecomposehermitian]

--8<-- [start:eigendecomposehermitian_ex2]
eigen_decompose_hermitian(H, 3, R),
EV is ++(R['eigenvalues'])    % 3 smallest eigenvalues
--8<-- [end:eigendecomposehermitian_ex2]

--8<-- [start:singularvaluedecompose]
singular_value_decompose(A, RESULT)
singular_value_decompose(A, K, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:singularvaluedecompose]

--8<-- [start:singularvaluedecompose_ex2]
singular_value_decompose(H, 2, R),
S is ++(R['s'])    % 2 largest singular values
--8<-- [end:singularvaluedecompose_ex2]


# === Lifecycle ===

--8<-- [start:free]
free(HANDLE)
--8<-- [end:free]
